detail.longDescription: I'd really like screenshots and what 9Front looks like as an operating system because...I am curious as fuck, but there really isn't anything on the site that fully paints a picture of that. However, I may simply need to comb the site with a fine comb to make that determination. As I would like a different kind of OS, yet, something that can be compatible with modern things. As if that is possible...Especially once I have expanded my abilities, I could do stuff with that. If there isn't a WM or DE environment, I could learn to bolt one on 9Front, get it configured properly. That could be fun. # 9Front # Questions # Research
